risks.basis: THIS FILE has a confirmed defect on record
risks.risk: api/sd-data-cross-tenant-dispatchers.test.js carried a section with app:null as a deliberate tripwire so that a gate arriving on six Tier A SAIRNgrounds resources could not pass unnoticed; the tripwire FIRED and nobody updated the config, so 14 arms reported UNREACHED on 401 NO_SESSION for as long as the gate had existed and those six resources had NO tenant-isolation coverage at all -- and the gate turned out to be a FIFTH mechanism nobody had catalogued, a named set plus hasOwnProperty pre-dispatch at api/sd-data.js:4343-4366 covering 21 resources, invisible to every scan keyed on the other four

risks.basis: the same app (sairngrounds) has this defect on record
risks.risk: 43 server writes with no timeout on any path: a hung fetch never returns from the await, so grdData's catch never runs and the toast naming what failed to sync never fires at all

risks.basis: the same app (sairngrounds) has this defect on record
risks.risk: cmSavePoints() read nothing from its push while all three callers toasted Point captured unconditionally, so a course point that never reached the server was announced as captured

risks.basis: the same app (sairngrounds) has this defect on record
risks.risk: sairngrounds and sairnscape reported a refused localStorage write to the USER and to nothing else: their storage catch toasted and logged nothing, so a write that vanished also vanished from the console and a support read of a browser log showed no trace. sairndental's copy of the same wrapper carries a console.error with the reason written beside it -- the line was added to one of three near-identical files when the stamping catch was split out on 2026-09-13

risks.basis: the same app (sairngrounds) has this defect on record
risks.risk: A deputy provisioning role (superintendent/hr/crew_lead) could deactivate the last active owner in SAIRNgrounds, SAIRNbiz and SAIRNscape: the last-admin guard counted over BOTH provisioning roles, so it never fired, the licence reached zero owners, and bootstrap's unfiltered existence check plus the non-owner-cannot-create-an-owner rule left no route back through the API.

risks.basis: the same app (sairngrounds) has this defect on record
risks.risk: Twenty-one SAIRNgrounds resources in api/sd-data.js required the licence key and NOTHING ELSE on both read and write -- no employee session at all, in an app that has had api/grd-auth.js, a grd_employee_auth table and a five-role vocabulary the whole time. Reachable and WRITABLE on the key alone: grd_invoices (money), grd_boq_rates (the rates every quote is priced from), grd_vendors, grd_quotes, grd_properties, grd_jobs and the rest. No personal data is on these rows; what was exposed is a golf operation commercial interior, and a former employee holding one key could rewrite the rate card. Measured by the auditor own artifact: 16 of 17 grd_* resources REPRODUCES on both actions, the seventeenth PARTIAL. CRITICAL on integrity rather than confidentiality: the write half is the severe half.
